_seed_meta.description: Checks a proposal against solicitation requirements, identifying formatting violations, missing sections, and eligibility concerns.

items.name: Sponsor Compliance Checker
items.description: Verifies that a proposal meets sponsor formatting, content, and eligibility requirements.

data.searchphrases: Sponsor Agency, FOA/Solicitation Number, Page Limits, Font Requirements, Margin Requirements, Required Sections, Submission Method, Certifications Required, Budget Constraints, Eligibility Requirements, Deadline, Format Requirements

data.prompt:
You are a sponsored programs compliance officer reviewing a proposal against sponsor requirements. Based on the extracted solicitation requirements and the full document, produce a compliance review:

## Formatting Compliance
- Page limits: within bounds?
- Font size and type: compliant?
- Margins: meet requirements?
- File format and naming conventions

## Content Compliance
- All required sections present?
- Required certifications and assurances included?
- Biographical sketches in correct format?
- Budget within sponsor constraints?

## Eligibility
- PI meets eligibility requirements?
- Institution eligible?
- Any restrictions on foreign participation?

For each item, rate as:
- **Compliant** - meets requirements
- **Non-Compliant** - specific violation identified
- **Unable to Determine** - insufficient information in document

End with a **Go/No-Go Recommendation** and list of items that must be corrected before submission.

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every page limit, font size, margin, dollar limit, deadline and date in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: Every solicitation requirement is rated
validation_plan.description: Each requirement the solicitation states (limits, required sections and material, certifications, budget constraints, eligibility, deadline) is rated against the proposal. Where an amendment changes a requirement, the amended requirement is the one applied. FAIL for each requirement skipped or checked against a superseded version.

validation_plan.name: No clearance without evidence
validation_plan.description: Every favourable conclusion (compliant, within limits, eligible) rests on something the document states. Where the document does not give enough to decide, the output says the item could not be determined and what is needed. FAIL if the output calls something compliant, complete, allowable or low-risk without stated support.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional solicitation, amendment and proposal draft. Answer key: the $200,000 direct-cost request exceeds the $180,000 cap by $20,000; budget arithmetic adds up (120,000 + 30,000 + 20,000 + 30,000 = 200,000; total 250,000) and indirect is 25% of direct; the budget justification is missing; the signed partner letter has not been received (a promise is not a letter); the draft still tracks the superseded November 12 deadline (now November 19, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time); no page limit or exception is stated.
validation_inputs.text:
FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL FUNDING OPPORTUNITY
Source ID: notice-v1
Community Resilience Pilot — original notice, October 1, 2026

1. Eligibility
An application must be submitted by a university research office. Each university
may submit one application. This notice does not specify citizenship eligibility.

2. Dates
The sponsor deadline is November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
The institutional review deadline is November 9, 2026 at noon Pacific Time.
The project period is July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028.

3. Budget
The maximum direct-cost request is $180,000. Indirect costs are additional and
may not exceed 25% of direct costs. Equipment purchases are not permitted.
Travel and subaward costs are allowed within the direct-cost limit.
This notice does not give an exception or waiver process.

4. Required material
Include a project narrative, an itemized budget, a budget justification and one
signed community-partner letter. The letter must arrive with the application.
The notice does not specify a page limit for the budget justification.

FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL FUNDING OPPORTUNITY
Source ID: amendment-v2
Community Resilience Pilot — official amendment, October 8, 2026

This amendment supersedes the sponsor deadline in section 2 of notice-v1.
The new sponsor deadline is November 19, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
The institutional review deadline remains November 9, 2026 at noon Pacific Time.
All other requirements, limits and project dates in notice-v1 remain unchanged.

FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL PROPOSAL
Source ID: proposal-draft
Community Resilience Pilot — working proposal, October 6, 2026
Principal investigator: Avery Example
Internal tracking deadline: November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time
Project period: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028

Draft budget
Personnel: $120,000
Travel: $30,000
Supplies: $20,000
Subaward: $30,000
Direct-cost total: $200,000
Indirect costs: $50,000
Total request: $250,000
Equipment: $0

Readiness notes
The project narrative and itemized budget are attached to the internal record.
The budget justification is not yet attached. A partner has promised a letter,
but a signed letter has not been received. No sponsor exception is documented.
